status: PMS now has a native property/room board read (Rooms and Housekeeping sections), an owner-local HTTP router, and a fail-closed Next transport/SSR/API cutover for those sections. Shared composition mounting, the Account/Holding backend, the People staff port and the Commercial package entitlement binding remain composition work, so no PMS workflow is claimed complete or browser-verified.

scope.domain: packages/server-pms/src/domain/room_board.rs owns the typed property summary, property/config, raw PMS record envelope, room summary, list metadata, staff option, board setup facts and workspace projection. PmsBoardActor enforces pms.read, the pms module, a branch/company selection without department, a current work-context expiry and one of pms.housekeeping/pms.inspect/pms.maintenance. PmsBoardEntitlement preserves the retained pms.front-desk package-history guard; PmsBoardVisibility filters rate, guest and financial facts before serialization.
scope.application: packages/server-pms/src/application/room_board.rs enforces the actor and package entitlement, validates Company/branch property scope, rejects a foreign or missing requested property with a scoped PMS_NOT_FOUND, applies pricing/guest/financial visibility, redacts the chart/accounts config unless accounting is granted, computes readiness from property setup facts, bounds properties/records/staff, and removes a selected id that is not visible.
scope.adapters: packages/server-pms/src/adapters/room_board.rs reads only pms_properties and pms_records inside a caller-owned serializable transaction. It keeps the exact Company/branch property predicate, returns all Property-filtered rooms up to 500, pages 50 room ids with the retained room filters, bounds room types/rates/tasks/blocks/in-house stays, reads only in-house guest/reservation/guest-account links when the actor has guest visibility, and computes room readiness counts. No cross-owner SQL is invented; staff labels and package entitlement are public application ports.
scope.http: packages/server-pms/src/adapters/pms_http.rs exposes GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/pms/rooms with one bounded query (section, property, status, q, building, floor, typeId, page, selectedId, from, to). It validates exact registered Host/Holding targets, rejects duplicates/unknown names/malformed percent encodings/oversized or invalid selections/request bodies, returns private/no-store and no-referrer/nosniff responses, and maps BusinessError to bounded statuses. Session resolution, selected Company scope, package entitlement, the serializable unit and People staff stay behind PmsHttpBackend.
scope.transport: packages/feature-pms/src/adapters/server/native-pms.ts validates ERPX_NATIVE_PMS_CONFIG (loopback only, no reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/8080 or owned app ports, exact unique HTTPS Holding origins, unique Hosts/slugs/ids, 250..30000 ms), forwards the actual session cookie, Host, branch/department selectors and rendered-context CAS headers, and strictly validates property/record/list-meta/room-summary/staff/booking/readiness fields plus the returned context identity and bounded response.
scope.ssr: packages/workplace/src/lib/native-pms.ts maps the retained WorkContext into the native page context. The PMS console Rooms/Housekeeping presenters and the standard Front daily entry read only through the native transport and return 503 NATIVE_PMS_UNAVAILABLE when ERPX_NATIVE_PMS_CONFIG is absent, malformed or failing. The existing GET /api/v1/holdings/{slug}/pms route also serves Rooms/Housekeeping natively and 503s without configuration. There is no silent TypeScript room-board fallback. All other PMS sections remain on the retained pmsWorkspace read; the POST command route is unchanged.
scope.notClaimed: No command cutover, shared composition mount, real Account/People/Commercial port implementation, browser journey, authenticated page render, staging or private production verification. No whole-workflow completion flag is changed.

postgresCases: board read is Company/branch scoped, returns only PMS-owned rows, keeps rooms/room types/in-house stays/tasks/maintenance blocks, excludes rates and guest rows for a housekeeping actor, redacts stay prices, and preserves the expected room summary plus staff readback
room filters, 50-row pagination and hasNext, selected-id visibility and the default 30/60-day list window are bounded
a foreign Company, foreign branch and missing requested property fail closed with PMS_NOT_FOUND; the selected property's own board remains readable
a missing transaction is rejected with PMS_BOARD_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED and a read-committed transaction with PMS_BOARD_SERIALIZABLE_REQUIRED
httpCases: the actual ephemeral loopback Router serves a Rooms/Housekeeping query, preserves Host/Holding/section/property/status/q/page/selectedId/from/to forwarding and private/no-referrer/nosniff headers
unknown Holding targets return 404; duplicate, unknown, malformed, oversized-page, incomplete-range, reversed-range and empty-id queries return 422 before the backend
a backend conflict maps to 409 and invalid/duplicate Holding targets or non-HTTPS origins are rejected
unitCases: read requires pms.read, the pms module, a branch/company selection, a current context and a room-board role
selection bounds page, status, query bytes and the 93-day date range
housekeeping filters rate/guest facts, redacts stay prices and booking policy, sorts/dedupes staff and serializes the transport field names
manager visibility retains pricing/guest records; hidden records and foreign properties fail closed
an enforced package without pms.front-desk history returns PACKAGE_REQUIRED
property readiness and booking facts follow config and setup facts; empty scope returns an explicit snapshot:null workspace

rustfmt.command: rustfmt --edition 2024 --check on all new PMS Rust and test files

transportCases: room board forwards the configured Holding, session cookie, selected branch and current CAS headers and returns the validated workspace
missing authority and a changed response context fail closed before transport
foreign Company properties, unrequested permissions, missing fields and duplicate record ids are rejected
bounded owner 409 errors map without a TypeScript fallback
fail-closed availability toggles only with ERPX_NATIVE_PMS_CONFIG
reserved loopback ports, non-loopback bases, non-HTTPS or duplicate Holding origins and undersized timeouts are rejected

removedReadConsumers: The PMS console Rooms and Housekeeping presenters no longer call pmsWorkspace; they read the native room board and fail closed with 503 NATIVE_PMS_UNAVAILABLE without ERPX_NATIVE_PMS_CONFIG.
The standard Front daily entry uses the native room board for rooms and housekeeping; it does not fall back to the TypeScript workspace reader.
The GET /api/v1/holdings/{slug}/pms route serves view=list&section=rooms|housekeeping through the native transport and 503s without configuration; its POST command route is unchanged.
retainedWithConsumers: packages/server-pms/src/public/pms.ts still exports pmsWorkspace for dashboard, reservations, front-desk, guest-accounts, cashier, inventory, guests, reports, night-audit and setup sections.

The retained front screens packages/workplace/src/routes/front/[holdingSlug]/[companySlug]/[app]/_screens/pms-rooms.tsx and pms-housekeeping.tsx still import pmsWorkspace but are not routed by the standard daily entry; they were not edited to avoid changing an unused legacy path.
All PMS command writers, idempotency, CAS, audit/outbox, Finance/Inventory/People same-transaction guards and rollback behavior remain TypeScript and unchanged.
Commercial package enforcement remains a public composition boundary; the native owner read models it as PmsBoardEntitlement and does not query Commercial tables.

limits: No shared composition backend is mounted, so no production/private route serves the owner router. The HTTP test backend is a recording fake.

The People staff and Commercial package entitlement ports are application contracts only; no production implementation exists in this slice. Composition must bind them before enabling ERPX_NATIVE_PMS_CONFIG.
Only property/room/housekeeping reads are native. Reservations, guest accounts, cashier, folios, inventory, reports, night audit, setup and all commands remain on the retained TypeScript path.
No browser, authenticated SSR render, Next dev server, public URL, staging, private production or Cloudflare verification was run.

The root Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, package lockfiles, src/composition/**, packages/contracts/**, docs/status/** and other owners' implementation were not edited by this slice. Concurrent uncommitted procurement/sales/composition work was preserved.
